question: Compute the 24-hour time-weighted average OpenSea listing floor for Pudgy Penguins on Ethereum mainnet, returning integer wei. CoinGecko collection id pudgy-penguins. Verify exact contract/project scope and OpenSea slug. Use historical OpenSea orders/listings and corroborate order status, cancellations and fulfillments with on-chain calls/events over the pinned window. A floor is the lowest valid public ask, not the last sale or mean sale. Follow pinned definitions. If historical order coverage is insufficient, report inability and do not submit a fabricated numeric answer.

definitions.twap: TWAPwei=floor(sum(F_i_wei * duration_i_seconds)/86400), integrating each piecewise-constant minimum-ask interval. Account for listing starts/expiries, cancellation, fulfillment and invalidation. Use exact integer/rational arithmetic. Do not use VWAP, average sale, mean of irregular samples, current floor or 24h low as TWAP.

definitions.scope: OpenSea collection slug pudgypenguins, Ethereum contract 0xbd3531da5cf5857e7cfaa92426877b022e612cf8 only; no wrapped or migrated collections.
definitions.listing: A valid public, single-NFT fixed-price OpenSea ask in ETH or WETH, with mandatory buyer fees included; bids, private orders, bundles, other currencies, sales and transfers are excluded.
definitions.coverage: No numeric floor computation was possible: OpenSea's historical events endpoint required an API key (HTTP 401), so opening asks and complete order history could not be verified from public data.
